sections.Profile:
The "Gladiators" pinball machine, manufactured by Gottlieb in 1993, offers players an exciting and unique fantasy-themed experience. Designed by Jon Norris with artwork by Constantino Mitchell, Jeanine Mitchell, and David Moore, the game is set in a futuristic world where players take on the role of gladiators battling various challenges.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1993
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: DMD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Fighting, Original Theme, 1990s, Solid State, Fantasy
